IN.note: input block: power it to open (the lever @L is the test harness)

L.note: test lever on the input block

ONL.note: lock while a close runs (28 ticks)

notes: 3x3 flush piston door: power the input block @IN to open (test lever @L on top); clear 32 ticks after the input goes on, solid 17 after it goes off; input-safe (any timing)

targets.name: lever
targets.description: open: side cells clear 8 ticks after the lever, all nine 32 after; close: solid 17 ticks after

targets.name: stone
targets.description: a stone button (20 ticks): the lockout lets the open finish, then the door closes

targets.name: spam
targets.description: a lever flipped every 3 ticks, 9 times (ends on): the door ends open; off at 150: closed again

targets.name: reopen
targets.description: close at 60, re-open 12 ticks later, re-close 12 after that: ends closed, then cycles (with lock delays of 8 and 24 this stuck)

targets.name: burnout
targets.description: failure case: 16 flips within 48 ticks burn out the input torch (8 turn-offs in 60 ticks, R-007): the door opens and stays open until the torch relights
